items.quote: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
items.contrast: The four descendants of Rapha are the defeated recipients; David and his men are the agents who defeated them.
items.reason: Although the nearby phrase “David and his men” could be mistaken for the answer, the passive wording “defeated by” asks for those defeated. The final verse explicitly identifies them as the four descendants of Rapha in Gath.
